title: fastapi-endpoint
summary: Guides the agent through exploring an existing FastAPI project, asking clarifying questions, planning an endpoint implementation for approval, and then building the endpoint and tests. It emphasizes async SQLAlchemy, Pydantic schemas, dependency-injected authentication, and API test coverage.

title: fastapi-templates
summary: Guides creation of structured FastAPI backend projects using async patterns, dependency injection, repository and service layers, authentication, and testing examples. Includes templates for API endpoints, database access, and user management.

title: api-design
summary: Guides the agent in designing and reviewing REST API contracts, covering resource URLs, HTTP behavior, response formats, pagination, security, rate limits, and versioning. It also provides implementation patterns and a checklist for endpoint readiness.

title: openapi-spec-generation
summary: Guides agents in creating and maintaining OpenAPI 3.1 specifications from design or code, validating API contracts, and generating SDKs and documentation. Includes patterns for reusable schemas, API descriptions, security, versioning, and validation tools.

title: api-testing
summary: Guides the agent in creating and running direct HTTP API tests with tools such as .http files, Bruno, Postman/Newman, and k6. Covers assertions, environment configuration, secret handling, and CI integration.

title: defense-in-depth
summary: Use defense-in-depth validation to prevent invalid data from causing failures deeper in execution. Trace data flow, add checks at each layer, and test whether later layers catch inputs that bypass earlier checks.

title: python-error-handling
summary: Guides agents to implement Python validation and error handling with meaningful exceptions, exception chaining, and resilient batch processing. It also recommends practices for domain-type conversion, progress reporting, logging, and testing error paths.

title: radar
summary: Add and refine tests, diagnose flaky behavior, and improve coverage while preserving product behavior. Follow the project’s existing testing conventions and verify changes with tests and relevant references.

title: integration-testing
summary: Guides agents to write integration tests that exercise multiple components together, using real dependencies and suitable test frameworks. Covers test isolation, API testing patterns, database cleanup, and CI configuration for Testcontainers.

title: tdd-workflow
summary: Follow a test-driven workflow by writing tests before implementation, running tests through development, and refactoring while keeping them green. Aim for at least 80% coverage across unit, integration, and E2E tests, with attention to edge cases and errors.

title: builder
summary: Guides the agent to implement production-ready, type-safe business logic, API integrations, and data models, with validation, error handling, and test handoffs. It emphasizes TypeScript strictness, domain-appropriate patterns, and Japanese final outputs.

title: python-testing-patterns
summary: Guides the agent in designing and implementing Python tests using pytest patterns, fixtures, mocks, and specialized testing techniques. It emphasizes focused, isolated tests and meaningful coverage of failure behavior.

title: tdd
summary: Follow a red-green-refactor workflow by writing focused behavior tests and implementing only enough code to pass each test. Plan around public interfaces and user-prioritized behavior, then refactor after tests pass.

title: contract-testing
summary: Guides agents in choosing and implementing contract-testing approaches to verify API compatibility between services. Covers Pact workflows, provider verification, Pact Broker and deployment checks, PactFlow, and Spring Cloud Contract.

title: backend-patterns
summary: Provides TypeScript-oriented backend patterns for API design, data access, query optimization, caching, error handling, authentication, rate limiting, background jobs, and logging. Recommends choosing patterns suited to the complexity level.

title: unit-testing
summary: Guides the agent to write and improve isolated unit tests using common testing patterns, test doubles, naming conventions, and language-specific frameworks. Emphasizes focused, deterministic tests and meaningful coverage.

title: variant-analysis
summary: Guides systematic searching for variants of a known vulnerability or bug, from understanding its root cause through generalizing patterns and triaging matches. Emphasizes broad codebase coverage, incremental query refinement, and checking edge cases and false positives.

title: owasp-security
summary: Apply OWASP security practices when implementing or reviewing application and agent code. Check for common vulnerabilities and favor secure handling of input, authentication, authorization, data, errors, and dependencies.

title: gateway
summary: Designs and reviews API contracts, producing OpenAPI specifications or GraphQL SDL along with examples, error formats, versioning recommendations, and security considerations. Favors backward compatibility, routes implementation work elsewhere, and records API design decisions in project files.

title: the-odds-api-automation
summary: Automate The Odds API operations through Rube MCP by discovering current tool schemas, checking the API connection, and executing schema-compliant tools. The skill also specifies session reuse, memory parameters, and pagination handling.

title: test-driven-development
summary: Follow a test-first development cycle: write a failing test, verify the failure, implement the minimum code to pass, then refactor while keeping tests green. Apply this approach to features, bug fixes, and integration debugging.

title: gorgias-automation
summary: Use the Rube MCP integration to manage Gorgias tickets, customers, tags, teams, and account activity from natural-language requests. Follow the documented API requirements and pagination, filtering, custom-field, rate-limit, and authentication guidance.

title: api-sports-automation
summary: Use Rube MCP to discover current API Sports tools and schemas, verify the API Sports connection, and execute workflows with schema-compliant arguments. Follow the skill’s guidance for session reuse, memory parameters, and pagination.

title: systematic-debug
summary: Use test bombs to narrow an unclear bug to a likely component, and layered tests to isolate the failing stage in a pipeline. Keep the resulting tests as regression coverage and use the identified failure to guide the fix.

title: migrate-to-shoehorn
summary: Migrate test files from TypeScript `as` assertions to `@total-typescript/shoehorn`, using `fromPartial()` for partial data and `fromAny()` for intentionally incorrect data. Install the package, update imports, and run a type check to verify the migration.

title: error-handling-patterns
summary: Guides agents in handling errors across Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Rust, and Go, including validation, cleanup, logging, and typed errors. Emphasizes preserving useful error context and handling errors at an appropriate level.

title: wycheproof
summary: Use Wycheproof test vectors to validate cryptographic implementations against known attacks and edge cases. Integrate the vectors into test harnesses and CI to check valid, invalid, and acceptable cases.

title: acceptance-testing
summary: Use BDD acceptance-testing practices to turn business requirements into executable specifications, step definitions, and CI-validated tests. Apply the guidance across Gherkin- and Gauge-based frameworks and keep specifications useful as living documentation.

title: provider-api
summary: Use the neutral `skill-router provider-api` CLI for hosted-provider APIs, explicitly configuring the endpoint and key before making calls. Load the platform’s provider-specific documentation when exact schemas, authentication, rate limits, or provider-only behavior are needed.

title: netsuite-automation
summary: Use the NetSuite toolkit to query and manage ERP records, including customers and sales orders. Check schemas, required fields, record references, and connection status when performing operations.

title: property-based-testing
summary: Use property-based testing proactively when it can strengthen coverage, especially for transformations, parsers, validators, algorithms, and smart contracts. Offer it as an option when a high-value pattern is found, adapt the recommendation when the codebase already uses a PBT library, and respect a user's decline.

title: thinking-scientific-method
summary: Use a scientific-method workflow for investigations: form falsifiable hypotheses, make predictions that distinguish true from false, test them, and revise conclusions using evidence. The skill is intended for debugging, experimentation, performance investigations, and related analysis.

title: n8n-code-javascript
summary: Guides the agent in writing and troubleshooting JavaScript for n8n Code nodes. It covers execution modes, input and webhook data access, return formats, and common implementation practices.

title: sslmate-cert-spotter-api-automation
summary: Automate Sslmate Cert Spotter API workflows through Rube MCP and Composio. Discover current tool schemas and verify the API connection before executing workflows.

title: coding-guidelines
summary: Use cautious, scope-limited coding practices: clarify uncertainty, favor simple solutions, and make only changes directly tied to the request. Define verifiable goals and verify code changes before considering the task complete.

title: security-review
summary: Apply a security checklist when reviewing or implementing application features, with emphasis on secrets, input handling, authentication, data exposure, API protections, and deployment readiness. Validate security-sensitive behavior and tests across web, database, and blockchain code.

title: n8n-code-python
summary: Guides agents writing Python for n8n Code nodes, including n8n data access and return formats, execution modes, and Python’s standard-library limitations. It recommends considering JavaScript first and using Python (Beta) for better n8n integration.

title: asin-data-api-automation
summary: Automates Asin Data API tasks through Rube MCP by discovering current tool schemas, checking the API connection, and executing the discovered tools. It also specifies session, memory, schema, and pagination practices.

title: secure-coding-practices
summary: Apply defensive security practices when designing, implementing, and reviewing applications. Validate inputs, protect sensitive data, use secure authentication and cryptography, and check dependencies and error-handling paths.

title: dynamics365-automation
summary: Use the Dynamics 365 CRM toolkit through Rube MCP to manage CRM records, including leads, accounts, contacts, opportunities, sales orders, invoices, and support cases. Check the toolkit connection before using tools and follow the documented reference and OData formats.

title: api-ninjas-automation
summary: Automates API Ninjas operations through Rube MCP by discovering current tool schemas, checking the API Ninjas connection, and executing schema-compliant tools. It also specifies session reuse, memory parameters, and pagination handling.

title: eodhd-apis-automation
summary: Automate EODHD API tasks through Rube MCP by discovering current tool schemas, checking the connection, and executing schema-compliant calls. Reuse sessions within workflows and continue paginated requests until results are complete.

title: upstash-qstash
summary: Guides the agent in building reliable serverless messaging workflows with Upstash QStash. It emphasizes signature verification, message handling, and operational reliability.

title: probe
summary: Use Probe for authorized, safe dynamic security testing, penetration-test planning, and runtime vulnerability verification. Verify findings and produce actionable security reports, following the skill’s routing, output, and safety requirements.

title: apify-automation
summary: Use the Composio Apify integration to run Actors, retrieve and manage datasets, create reusable tasks, and inspect runs and logs. Check Actor-specific input requirements and use pagination or asynchronous runs when appropriate.

title: microservices-patterns
summary: Guide the design and implementation of microservices using service boundaries, inter-service communication, distributed data patterns, and resilience techniques. Apply architectural patterns such as API gateways, event-driven communication, sagas, and circuit breakers.

title: sql-injection-testing
summary: Guide the agent through SQL injection vulnerability assessment, including detection, exploitation techniques, and reporting. Require authorization and scope boundaries, and constrain data extraction and disruptive testing.

title: setup-pre-commit
summary: Guides the agent through configuring Husky pre-commit hooks with lint-staged, Prettier, type checking, and tests. It also covers package-manager detection, conditional setup, verification, and committing the resulting changes.

title: algorand-vulnerability-scanner
summary: Guides security audits of Algorand smart contracts by identifying platform-specific vulnerabilities in TEAL and PyTeal, checking transaction validation and access controls, and using Tealer where available. It also recommends exploit-based tests and reports findings with severity and remediation guidance.

title: amazon-automation
summary: Automates Amazon tasks through Rube MCP by discovering current tool schemas, checking the Amazon connection, and executing schema-compliant workflows. It also guides session reuse, memory inclusion, and pagination handling.
